lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a roughly linear, staggered formation along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a visible grid-like matrix across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing higher density and smaller diameters toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency distribution of small-diameter, high-luminance spots is localized on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
